paragraphs.source_en: The provisions were nearly enough to sustain an army of three hundred thousand men and twenty thousand horses for a year. Never before had such a quantity been gathered from Sakai at Amagasaki, Hyogo, and other places, then carried by sea to Akamagaseki. The rice shipped from Sakai alone already exceeded fifty thousand koku. Many vessels of two or three hundred koku had been summoned from more than twenty places, but ships capable of carrying a thousand koku were few, so every vessel and every person was frantically busy.

paragraphs.source_en: Shoan stared into space for a long while without speaking. War was not waged for profit alone; ambition, reputation, and much else were entangled in it, making it exceedingly complex. With Shimazu Yoshihisa's strength alone, he was in truth no match for Hideyoshi. This war could bring Yoshihisa nothing but harm, and it was also gravely obstructing Sakai's overseas trade.
